verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details cart creation, checkout, webhooks, refunds, disputes, and catalog tools, but nowhere documents an agent-identifier field on orders/transactions or any reporting/filtering capability by originating agent (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.). In fact Store Sync docs state orders arrive in the merchant's order management system 'just as it would from any other channel,' implying no special agent attribution surfaced for reporting.
